evidence.source_statement: When an authorized fork integration produces competing edits, identify the affected fork-specific patches and upstream changes, choose an explicit resolution supported by the approved task, and verify that intended behavior is preserved; never treat an automatic merge or rebase result as authorization to discard a local customization.
source_conditions: When authorized upstream integration affects local behavior or patches.
source_exceptions: Behavioral changes and unresolved conflicts must be surfaced; do not invent authorization to discard customizations.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
